scope: Local native microbenchmarks with alternating execution order and three samples. These are individual operation comparisons, not end-to-end or remote-I/O speedup claims.

comparisons.wide_column_cache: Eight integer columns, 1024 rows, sequential reconstruction after writing input. Four active cache entries versus the bounded cache for the active column set; identical checksums. 8192 versus 144 decoded records.
comparisons.owned_column_transfer: 4096 rows, eight columns including repeated 384-byte text; 16 repeats. Reconstruct rows and clone a typed store versus reference-counted spans of the existing store; identical checksums. Queue and scheduling costs are excluded.
comparisons.primitive_numeric_hash: 100000 alternating integer and fractional float keys from 1024 values. Prior exact decimal conversion/hash versus normalized dyadic primitive hashing. Hash encodings differ; each path checks stable checksums and separate equivalence tests check primitive/decimal/mixed-number equality. Software wide-integer decimal conversion dominates the reference; this ratio is not a join or grouping throughput claim.
